remarks:
Welcome Home to 54 Park Lane Ct, located in PRIME Williamsville location...-Beautifully situated Condo nestled on a quite cul-de-sac.. Designed for effortless luxury living.  offering 1890 square feet of inviting space, this home blends comfort, convenience and style with a thoughtful layout makes everyday living feel elevated.  The spacious primary bedroom features its own private en-suite bath with a jetted tub, while the 2nd bedroom is ideally located near the full 2nd guest bath creating  a welcoming  retreat for family or guests.

At the heart of the home, the fully equipped eat in Kitchen includes all appliances and opens to a private deck, which offers the perfect setting for coffee in the morning , casual meals or quite evenings outdoors.

The private laundry area is located on the first floor, not far from your built in one car garage.

Off the garage is the furnace and hot water tank + A generator hookup.

The low maintenance lifestyle allows you to spend more time enjoying everything Williamsville has to offer

Ideally located near shopping, dining, parks and more this is a wonderful opportunity  to enjoy comfort convenience and refined condo living in a highly desirable setting.
